messages.content: ma sushil, chitwan bata. mero hajurama ko naam thaha chha timilai?
thaha chhaina. tapai le afno naam sushil ra thau chitwan matra bhannubhayo; hajurama ko naam bhannubhayeko chhaina.
messages.steps: diyeko: naam sushil, thau chitwan. sodheko: hajurama ko naam. diyeko chhaina.

messages.content: ma pokhara ma baschhu. mero sathi kaha baschha?
tapai pokhara ma basnuhunchha, tara sathi kaha baschha bhanera tapai le bhannubhayeko chhaina.
messages.steps: diyeko: user = pokhara. sodheko: sathi. diyeko chhaina.

messages.content: mero didi ko naam rita ho ra bhai ko naam kamal. didi ko naam k ho?
tapai ki didi ko naam rita ho.
messages.steps: diyeko: didi = rita, bhai = kamal. sodheko: didi.

messages.content: mero didi ko naam rita ho ra bhai ko naam kamal. mero naam k ho?
tapai ko afnai naam bhannubhayeko chhaina. didi rita ra bhai kamal matra bhannubhayo.
messages.steps: diyeko: didi = rita, bhai = kamal. sodheko: user ko naam. chhaina.

messages.content: hamro school ma 400 bidyarthi chhan. shikshak kati jana chhan?
bidyarthi 400 jana bhannubhayo, tara shikshak kati jana bhanne kura diyeko chhaina.
mero umer 20 ho. mero bhai kati barsha ko hola?
tapai 20 barsha ko hunuhunchha, tara bhai ko umer bhannubhayeko chhaina, tyasaile ma anuman garna sakdina.

ram le 5 ota syau kinyo. sita le kati syau kini?
ram le 5 ota syau kinyo bhanne matra diyeko chha. sita le kati kini bhanne kura chhaina.
mero ghar ma kukur chha, naam bhote. mero biralo ko naam k ho?
tapai le kukur ko naam bhote bhannubhayo, tara biralo ko barema kehi bhannubhayeko chhaina. tapai sanga biralo pani chha?
aaja sombar ho. bholi kun bar?
bholi mangalbar hunchha.
